problem: The price $P(t)$ of a particular good varies according to the differential equation ${P}^{′}(t)=rP(t),$ where $t$ is the time, measured in years, and $r>0.$ It is known that the price of the good tripled after the first six years. How long did it take for the price to double from the initial price?

activity_context.topic_title: Exponential Growth and Decay Models With First-Order ODEs: Calculating Unknown Times and Initial Values
